Bridgeman Wins Biltmore Championship
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Jacob Bridgeman won the 2026 Biltmore Championship at The Cliffs at Walnut Cove, Asheville, NC
- Final score: 26-under 258 (four rounds)
- Winning margin: 2 shots over Ben James
- Winner's check: $900,000
- This is his SECOND PGA Tour win of 2026 (confirmed by GolfDigest winner's bag article)
- Bridgeman was named a Presidents Cup captain's pick by Brandt Snedeker (announced Sept. 1)
**Sources:** The Golf News Net, Golf.com, GolfDigest, PGA Tour official

research.facts:
Presidents Cup Preview
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Dates: September 24-27, 2026
- Venue: Medinah Country Club, Medinah, Illinois
- USA Captain: Brandt Snedeker
- USA auto qualifiers: Scottie Scheffler, Cameron Young, Wyndham Clark, Sam Burns, Russell Henley, Collin Morikawa
- USA captain's picks: Chris Gotterup, Xander Schauffele, Justin Thomas, Jacob Bridgeman, Patrick Cantlay, Jackson Koivun
- International Captain: Geoff Ogilvy
- International auto qualifiers: Si Woo Kim, Hideki Matsuyama, Ryan Fox, Tom Kim, Min Woo Lee, Adam Scott
- Jackson Koivun: 21 years old, turned pro from Auburn, first Presidents Cup
- Medinah hosted Ryder Cups in 1991, 1999, and 2012
- USA record: 13 wins in 15 Presidents Cup editions
- Format: 30 matches over 4 days; fourballs Day 1 (Sept. 24, 12:30-7PM), foursomes Day 2; singles final day
- Broadcast: NBC and Golf Channel
- Unlike Ryder Cup, matches can end in ties (half point each)
**Sources:** PGA Tour, Wikipedia 2026 Presidents Cup, Last Word on Sports, Chicago Golf Report

research.facts:
LIV Golf Restructuring
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- LIV Golf filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy: September 8, 2026
- Assets: $100M-$500M; liabilities: $500M-$1B
- BC Partners (London PE firm) investing $300M in new financing
- 35-day player commitment deadline from petition date = approximately October 13, 2026
- Requirement: 2/3 in dollar amount of eligible player claims + 1/2 in number of players must commit
- Restructured entity: majority owned by players
- PIF providing $49.6M DIP financing (court approval pending)
- CEO: Scott O'Neil
- Four 2027 events announced: Saudi Arabia, Australia, South Africa, Hong Kong
- Jon Rahm owed $100M+; declined PGA Tour return offer
- PIF estimated total investment in LIV: ~$6B
- BC Partners receive: right to buy expansion team for $1 after 2 more teams added; 2% of all revenue for 7 years after profitability
- Expected re-emergence: early 2027
**Sources:** Sportico (2 articles), LIV Golf official, Wikipedia LIV Golf
